findings.diagnosis: W2, 'Faster onboarding', combines ON, shortening signup to one screen for faster onboarding, with BILL, producing monthly invoices for billing accuracy. These are distinct outcomes with different completion criteria, so a single workstream obscures sequencing and what done means.
findings.recommended_action: Consider keeping ON in Faster onboarding and moving BILL to an outcome-led Billing accuracy workstream, subject to human agreement.
